sample_positions: source x=3*x+1, source y=3*y+1, x=0..639, y=0..359
header_fields: independent image id uint32 (bit31 set; not the YOLO DDR source_count)
timing: Native camera cadence: normal 30 FPS target, LOW 5 FPS; hardware capture FIFO, hardware CRC32/IPv4/UDP packet generation, CPU telemetry priority at packet boundaries.
incomplete_frame_policy: Never publish partial images. Incorrect source geometry/queue overflow omits final chunk; host discards incomplete assembly after 3 s.
telemetry_protocol: BMON0001, 128 bytes, two identities, boxes, alarms, sensors, power and timing
matching_rule: Autonomous image IDs are distinct from YOLO DDR source_count. Do not falsely claim exact AI-frame boxes/thumbnails; existing exact timestamp+identity matching still applies to old protocols.
color_source: Read-only post-gamma 1920x1080 sensor tap; same ISP/AE/AWB as HDMI, sampled 3:1 in hardware; no CPU pixel copies or DDR reader
legacy_compatible: Host also accepts TCAM1601 gray8 and TCAM5651 160x90 RGB565 with their distinct strict layouts
browser_transport: PC memory MJPEG; compatibility PNG and CSV snapshots saved at most once per second
